bio.text: Chad Behn, a Republican, represents District 48 in the Iowa House of Representatives; the Iowa Legislature's biography lists Behn as serving a first term and as a farmer.
The biography says Behn was a Boone County supervisor from 2016 to 2020.

It lists an associate's degree from Des Moines Area Community College and a bachelor's degree in communication from Presentation College in Aberdeen, South Dakota, and says Behn was born in 1977 in Boone and lives there.
